paragraphs.text:
The little man refuses to walk, so your party carries him. By 
noon he appears to have fallen unconscious. You set up camp 
and try once more to feed your captive. He refuses; he seems to 
be actually willing himself to die.

By  morning  he  is  dead;  his  corpse  rots  rapidly.  Carrying  it 
becomes  a  repugnant  prospect.  Even  the  bones  fall  apart  and 
crumble to gray dust in only a few days. So much for your specimen.

To continue your homeward march, go to 158. To reverse course and 
explore the North Hanninah Valley, go to 89.
